title: Di María vs France · 2022 World Cup final

lines.text: Argentina, under pressure in their own half.
France have pushed up. If Argentina play through them, there is space to attack.
Messi turns it round the corner...
Álvarez releases Mac Allister! Argentina are away now!
Across to Di María...
Di María scores! Two-nil to Argentina! What a magnificent counterattack!
That's why the forward pass matters. Mac Allister keeps running, and Di María finishes the move.
Barcelona keep working the ball, looking for a way through.
Bayern are narrow. Messi has room on this side.
Here is Messi, taking on Boateng...
He's gone past Boateng!
And over Neuer! Messi, that is absolutely magnificent!
He makes Boateng commit, then shifts onto his right foot. Neuer comes out, and Messi just lifts it over him.
He makes it look so simple, doesn't he?
That's balance and composure. The defender goes down; Messi stays in complete control.
Watch how Wilshere keeps moving.
Cazorla into Wilshere... now Giroud.
And Wilshere is through!
Wilshere scores! What a magnificent Arsenal move!
That's the difference. He doesn't admire the pass; he keeps going, and Giroud gives it straight back.
All those touches, and Norwich cannot get near them.
One touch each. It's the movement that makes every pass possible.
Ronaldo has the free kick. Portugal need a goal to get back level.
He needs height over the wall, but enough dip to bring it back under the bar.
Cristiano Ronaldo...
Oh, what a goal! Ronaldo has rescued Portugal! Three-three!
Just look at the shape on that. It clears the wall and bends into the corner. De Gea barely moves.
What a way to bring Portugal back into this game.

title: Ferran Torres vs Betis · 2025 La Liga

lines.text: Barcelona are looking for the opening down the right.
Betis are holding their shape. A run beyond the full-back could open this up.
Koundé combines... and there's the overlap!
Low across the face of goal...
Ferran Torres scores! Barcelona are level! They've worked that beautifully down the right.
That's the run they needed. The extra man on the outside pulls Betis across, and Torres arrives in front of his marker.
An excellent response from Barcelona. They are right back in this.
